unsupported: The store is part of the national Rockler chain, which specializes in woodworking tools, hardware, and supplies.
Customers range from hobbyists and DIY enthusiasts to professional woodworkers and cabinetmakers.
The store’s expanded drawer slide selection and exclusive Rockler products cater to cabinet and furniture makers, while classes attract beginners and experienced makers alike.

The location differentiates itself through hands-on education, community-focused events, and an expanded in-store selection of premium brands like Festool abrasives and track saws, aiming to be a local hub for woodworkers.
